manifest.name: dsh-plugin-development
manifest.description: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins, and registers it as a skill root on install

bundle.text:
# dsh-plugin-development bundle patch
#
# Registers this package's own `skills/` directory as an extra skill root, so
# installing the plugin is what puts the skill in place. Same mechanism the
# shipped agent presets use for their bundled skills; `baseUrl` resolves to
# this package, so the path follows wherever it is installed.
#
# `providerName` must be unique per package: the skill registry rejects a second
# provider under the same name, so the default ("filesystem") collides with the
# harness' own provider and with any other plugin built on this mechanism.
# `includeDefaultRoots: false` keeps this provider to its own directory, since
# the harness' default provider already scans the project and user roots.

- insert:
    - id: dsh-plugin-development-skills
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
      config:
        providerName: dsh-plugin-development
        includeDefaultRoots: false
        customSkillDirs:
          - !!js "process.getBuiltinModule('node:url').fileURLToPath(new URL('skills/', baseUrl))"

readme.text:
一个 DSH 插件，内容只有一份技能：安装时把包内的 `skills/` 注册为一个技能根，于是这份技能随插件进入 agent 的技能目录。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-development
```

- **双半包骨架**：`package.json` 的必要字段（`main` / `exports["./client"]` / `dsh.bundle.patch` / `dsh.client`）、`cordis.patch.yml`、手写的 ModuleLoader client 半
- **对着 fork 开发**：把 fork link 进一个丢弃式试验 profile，三级验证（配置组合 → 模块解析 → 真执行），以及 `dsh plugin` 与 profile 的关系
- **发布与上线**：推 GitHub / 发 npm，把新版本部署到正在运行的 profile 而不碰它的安装状态
- **坑清单**：包括宿主插件跑 PowerShell 子进程才会遇到的三个（AMSI 拦胖脚本、stdout 编码、编译缓存失效），以及「插件装了但界面不出现」的排查链

```
package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch → cordis.patch.yml
cordis.patch.yml    # 插入一行 @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem，customSkillDirs 指向 skills/
skills/
  dsh-plugin-development/

`cordis.patch.yml` 用的机制和 DSH 自带 agent preset 装载自己的技能是同一套：`!!js` 里的 `baseUrl` 解析到本包，所以路径跟着安装位置走。
